UKMTO Warning 223-26 (and JMIC Advisory Update 117) reports an attack at 13:00 UTC (17:00 Gulf Standard Time) on 25 November 2026 in which an outbound tanker was struck by an unknown projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz 18 nautical miles east of Khasab, Oman.

On 25 November 2026, the European Parliament approved the conciliation joint text of the 2027 EU budget (A10-0305/2026) with 406 votes in favour, 184 against, and 69 abstentions, which is fewer than the 420 votes in favour required by the criterion.

The Ukrainian Air Force's morning summary for the night of November 24-25, 2026 (repeated by Ukrinform and Ukrainska Pravda) reported that Russia launched 112 attack drones (including 66 jet-powered Shaheds, Gerbera, and Parodiya decoys), which is fewer than 150.
ČTK reports that the second reading of the 2027 state budget bill ended after midnight Prague time on Thursday, November 26, outside the November 25 window.
On 25 November 2026, the European Parliament gave consent to the EU–Switzerland package in a single plenary vote on A10-0236/2026, with 584 votes in favour, 13 against, and 60 abstentions.
The Council confirmed that the summit took place in Brussels on 25 November 2026 and published the written Brussels Declaration in the name of the EU leaders before the 23:59 deadline.

opinions.note: Iowa Public Radio reported that Army officials confirmed the controlled detonation of degraded lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown on Wednesday, November 25, 2026.

HowTheyVote.eu shows that on 25 November 2026 the European Parliament gave its consent to the EU–Switzerland broad package of agreements (report A10-0236/2026, procedure 2025/0162(NLE)) by 584 votes in favour, 13 against, and 60 abstentions.
Xinhua, citing CMSA, reports that the Long March 2F carrying the crewed Shenzhou-24 spacecraft lifted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center at 08:18 Beijing time on November 25, 2026.

The US Army carried out the controlled detonation of nearly five tons of degraded lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa, at approximately 9:00 a.m. CST on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, as confirmed by the Army and reported by CNN and Iowa Public Radio.
The Council of the EU published the Brussels Declaration adopted by EU leaders at the EU-Western Balkans summit held in Brussels on 25 November 2026.
The BEA’s second estimate reported that U.S. real GDP grew 4.3 percent from Q2 to Q3 2026 at a seasonally adjusted annual rate.

According to ČT24 and ČTK, the ten-hour second reading of the 2027 state budget bill (print 324) began after noon on Wednesday 25 November 2026 and closed shortly after midnight on Thursday 26 November 2026.
BEA’s November 25 release reported that the PCE price index excluding food and energy was 3.3% higher in October 2026 than in October 2025.

Xinhua reports that the crewed Shenzhou-24 spaceship atop a Long March-2F carrier rocket blasted off from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center at 8:18 a.m. Beijing Time on Wednesday, November 25, 2026.

According to the BEA news release 'GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits, 3rd Quarter 2026' published on November 25, 2026, U.S. real GDP increased at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 4.3 percent in the third quarter of 2026.
Ofgem announced that the 1 January to 31 March 2027 cap would be £2,166 a year for a typical dual-fuel household paying by Direct Debit, exceeding the £2,154 threshold.
The BEA's Personal Income and Outlays release for October 2026 states that the PCE price index excluding food and energy increased 3.3 percent from one year ago.
The ABS reported that the All groups CPI (original series, weighted average of eight capital cities) rose 4.9 per cent in the 12 months to October 2026.

JMIC Advisory Note Update 117 and UKMTO warnings 217-26 through 223-26 show that the time-late reports issued on 24 November 2026 (UKMTO 218-26 through 221-26) were all for attacks that occurred on 22 November 2026, with the next reported incidents (222-26 and 223-26) taking place on 25 November 2026, leaving no qualifying incident that occurred on 24 November 2026.

Deere’s release forecast fiscal 2027 net income attributable to Deere & Company of $4.50–$5.25 billion, whose $4.875 billion midpoint was $15 million above the reported fiscal 2026 net income of $4.860 billion.

The Australian Bureau of Statistics' Consumer Price Index, Australia, October 2026 release published on 25 November 2026 reports that the headline annual CPI (All groups CPI, original series) rose 4.9% in the 12 months to October 2026.

HowTheyVote.eu records that the European Parliament adopted the resolution on media freedom and the rule of law in Czechia on 25 November 2026, with 442 votes in favour in the final vote on the text as a whole.
The ČNB press release confirms that the Bank Board left the countercyclical capital buffer rate unchanged at 1.5% at its November 25, 2026 financial-stability meeting.

Both the European Parliament press release and HowTheyVote.eu confirm that on 25 November 2026 the European Parliament adopted the resolution on media freedom and rule of law in the Czech Republic (RC-B10-0508/2026) in the final vote on the text as a whole by 442 votes in favour, 158 against, and 47 abstentions.
The official ČNB press release states that at its financial stability meeting on 25 November 2026, the ČNB Bank Board decided to leave the countercyclical capital buffer rate unchanged at 1.5%.

On 25 November 2026, Ofgem announced that the energy price cap for 1 January to 31 March 2027 will rise by 26% to £2,166 a year for a typical dual-fuel household paying by Direct Debit, which is above the £2,154 threshold.

In its 25 November 2026 fourth-quarter earnings release, Deere & Company reported fiscal 2026 net income attributable to Deere & Company of $4.860 billion and forecasted fiscal 2027 net income attributable to Deere & Company in a range of $4.50 to $5.25 billion, whose midpoint ($4.875 billion) is higher than the reported fiscal 2026 figure.
